import re, zipfile, os

src = 'sales_data.xlsx'
tmp = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(src)
items = {n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}

# --- Modify sheet1.xml ---
sheet = items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
sheet = sheet.replace('<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>')
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="15" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>'
)

row_re = re.compile(r'(<row r="(\d+)"[^>]*>)(.*?)(</row>)', re.S)
def append_cell(m):
    open_tag, r, body, close = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4)
    if r == '1':
        cell = '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c>'
    elif r == '10':
        cell = '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>'
    else:
        cell = '<c r="H%s" s="3"><f>G%s/E%s</f><v></v></c>' % (r, r, r)
    return open_tag + body + cell + close

sheet = row_re.sub(append_cell, sheet)
items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')

# --- Modify styles.xml: add 0.0% number format + two styles ---
styles = items['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles = styles.replace(
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>'
)
styles = styles.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="5">')
styles = styles.replace(
    '</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/>'
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/>'
    '</cellXfs>'
)
items['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

# --- Write new workbook, preserving all other parts ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in items.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)

os.replace(tmp, src)
print('Done. Column H (Profit Margin %) added.')
